description: This PHP file contains functions for generating XML and HTML representations of system hardware information, including CPU, PCI, IDE, SCSI, and USB devices, using data from a system info object.

methods.name: xml_hardware
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing the hardware components of the system, including CPU, PCI, IDE, SCSI, and USB devices, based on system info data.

methods.name: html_hardware
methods.description: Generates an HTML table displaying hardware information such as CPU details and connected devices, using XPath data.
